The '''Photon Pathway''' is a location in the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Purpose ==
In order to reach the {{zone|Stillgore Chateau}}, the player must parkour across floating islands with lasers sweeping across them. The parkour can be skipped by paying {{NPCSprite|Phaser}} {{Motes|150000}}. Once the player reaches the end of the parkour, {{NPCSprite|Phaser}} will transport them to the end for free.

{{NPCSprite|Deer}} lies on the island at the end of the parkour. If the player has a {{Item|Rift Boat}} in their inventory, they can talk to {{NPCSprite|Deer}} to be transported to the {{zone|Stillgore Chateau}}.

Located inside a building, the player can find the ninth [[Montezuma Pet|Montezuma Soul Piece]] at {{Coords|152|80|-14}}. Finding the soul piece will add an additional {{stat|rt|+15}} to the [[Montezuma Pet|Pet]].

== Trivia ==
*The '''Photon Pathway''' is the [[Rift]] equivalent to a river isolating the {{zone|Stillgore Chateau}} from the rest of the Island. Speaking to Deer with the {{Item|Rift Boat}} sends the player across the river triggering water particles along the players trajectory and playing splashing sounds.
**In traditional [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vampire#/ vampire] folklore vampires are unable to cross rivers.<ref>https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vampire#Protection</ref> Famously [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Count_Dracula#Limitations_of_his_powers/ Count Dracula]could only cross running water at low or high tide. He is unable to fly across a river in the form of a bat or mist nor even by himself aboard a boat unless he is physically carried.<ref>https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Count_Dracula#cite_note-Dracula,_Chapter_18-33</ref>
**The Rift Guide states that "{{Grey|A {{red|cult}} of {{red|vampires}} has settled in the castle. Beware being sent to their {{red|prison}}.}}", however the existence of the river implies they are unable to cross to the mainland.
